headline: Google DeepMind preprint extends Boyd-family records across high polynomial degrees
summary: A Google DeepMind preprint presents a five-parameter extension of Boyd's construction for small Mahler-measure polynomials. The authors report verified irreducible examples below Boyd's limit point at all 995 even degrees they evaluate from 12 to 2000, including six improvements over published values. This advances finite-degree records but does not settle Lehmer's conjecture or prove every listed polynomial globally minimal; the reported results have not been independently reproduced in this review.
